quote: Dirichlet (1849) studied the summatory divisor function D(x) and the associated error term in estimating the number of divisors
note: The divisor problem is the k=1 case of the Piltz divisor problem. Dirichlet's original 1849 work is the direct origin of this specific problem, predating Piltz's generalization to k>1.
